# C2PA Technical Specification

> C2PA (Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity) defines an end-to-end, open technical standard for certifying the provenance and history of digital media content.

## Core Specification

- [Content Credentials](specifications/2.5/specs/C2PA_Specification.html.md): C2PA (Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity) defines an end-to-end, open technical standard for certifying the provenance and history of digital media content.
